name: Sládkovičovo (Slovakia)
description: Ten equal horizontal stripes of yellow, yellow, green, green, white, white, green, green, yellow and yellow, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature S-7/91.
